headline: EXL beat Q3 EPS by 11% and raised full-year EPS guidance 2.6% above consensus, after the close
reasoning: Source: EXL's release on GlobeNewswire ('EXL Reports 2026 Third Quarter Results', 18:01 ET); figures first on Benzinga at 16:02 ET.

Quoted: 'Q3 Adj. EPS $0.62 Beats $0.56 Estimate, Sales $634.000M Beat $615.431M Estimate'. 'Raises FY2026 Adj EPS Guidance from $2.25-$2.29 to $2.34-$2.36 vs $2.29 Est; Raises FY2026 Sales Guidance from $2.390B-$2.415B to $2.430B-$2.440B vs $2.410B Est'. The release: revenue 'a 19.7% increase year-over-year'; CEO Rohit Kapoor says 'momentum has accelerated throughout the year'.
What changed: the year is running ahead of both the company's own plan and analysts'. The new EPS range's bottom ($2.34) sits above the old range's top ($2.29) and above consensus ($2.29).

Timing: after the close; no session has traded it. After hours: no IEX trades against the 40.86 close, so the reaction is unknown. The stock fell 4.8% over the three sessions before the report (42.91 on 10/22 to 40.86), on 311,667 shares Tuesday, about 2x its recent volume.
objections: No after-hours price on IEX: we cannot see how much of this the market has already priced.
